tables.title: Team members, pay and billable time
tables.hint: One row for each team member and helper with cost and charge-out rate per hour; hours, billable share, value of time and workload for the last 90 days come from the timesheet.

tables.title: Timesheet: every hour for every brand
tables.hint: One row for each block of work: who, which brand, what kind of work and how long; the rate, the cost of the time and the value if billable fill in by themselves.

tables.title: Billing and admin tasks with owner and hours
tables.hint: One row for each task with owner, due date and hours; the hours left, days to go and a flag for late and due soon tasks fill in.

tables.title: Leave, training and cover
tables.hint: One row for each absence with who covers; the days, working days, hours lost and whether the person is away now fill in.

tables.title: Invoices to clients with tax, balance and late fee
tables.hint: One row for each invoice with its net amount and due date; the tax, total, paid, balance, days overdue, late fee and status fill in from the payments.

tables.title: Payments received and how late they were
tables.hint: One row for each payment against an invoice; the brand, the days from issue to payment and whether it came on time fill in.

tables.title: Receivables ageing by client
tables.hint: One row for each client with the agreed terms; billed, paid, open balance and the balance by age (not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days) come from the invoices.

tables.title: Recurring retainers and the next invoice
tables.hint: One row for each monthly retainer with fee, start and billing day; the months running, the amount billed so far, the next invoice date and the yearly value fill in.

tables.title: Out-of-scope work and what it should earn
tables.hint: One row for each extra request outside the package; the price at your standard rate, your cost, the margin and the amount still to recover fill in.

tables.title: Expenses: tools, freelancers and costs for clients
tables.hint: One row for each expense with its kind and the brand it belongs to; mark whether you charge it on to the client. The month and the brand fill in.

tables.title: Tool subscriptions and what they cost for each client
tables.hint: One row for each tool with price, cycle, seats and use; the cost a month and a year, the cost for each seat and each active client and the renewal warning fill in.

tables.title: Profit by client over the last 12 months
tables.hint: One row for each brand; revenue, hours, cost of time, direct expenses, profit, margin and the real rate for each hour come from invoices, timesheet and expenses.

tables.title: Profit by package
tables.hint: One row for each package with its list price and planned hours; the clients on it, revenue, hours, profit, margin and the real revenue for each hour fill in.

tables.title: Profit and loss for every month
tables.hint: One row for each month with your other income and overhead; revenue, cost of time, expenses, profit and margin fill in from invoices, the timesheet and expenses.

tables.title: Cash flow forecast for the next 12 months
tables.hint: One row for each coming month with the new sales and one-off costs you expect; retainers, collections, team cost, tools, overhead and the cash balance fill in.

tables.title: Tax to set aside every month
tables.hint: One row for each month with the money you moved to your tax account; tax collected, tax paid on costs, income tax on profit, the amount to set aside and the gap fill in.

tables.title: Rate review for every kind of work
tables.hint: One row for each kind of work with your rate, the market rate and your cost; hours worked, value, margin, the suggested new rate and what the raise would add fill in.

tables.title: Hiring plan and what each hire must earn
tables.hint: One row for each possible hire with hours, pay and set-up cost; the monthly cost with employer costs, the value of the hours, the monthly gain and the months to pay back fill in.

tables.title: Utilisation by team member and month
tables.hint: One row for each team member and month with the client hours available; hours logged, billable hours, utilisation, value and the result against your target fill in.

tables.title: Price increase plan for every client
tables.hint: One row for each client with the percentage you plan and the date; the new fee, the extra each month and each year and the brand fill in.

guide: Open Start and type your agency name, your currency, the tax on invoices, your payment terms, your standard rate and cost per hour and your targets in the yellow cells.
Fill Team Members with each person, their cost per hour, charge-out rate and client hours a week. Hours, utilisation and workload fill in from the timesheet.
Log every block of work on Timesheet: date, person, brand, kind of work, hours and whether it is billable. The rate, cost of time and value fill in.
Raise each invoice on Invoices and each payment on Payments Received. Tax, balance, days overdue and the late fee fill in, and Receivables Ageing shows who to chase.
Keep Recurring Retainers and Price Increases up to date so you know the next invoice date, the income a year and the extra each increase brings.
Write every extra request on Out Of Scope Work so the price and the amount still to recover are never forgotten.
Enter expenses and tool subscriptions. Profit By Client and Profit By Package show where the money is made and lost, and Monthly Profit And Loss adds the overhead.
Check Cash Flow Forecast and Tax Set Aside every month, set the cash you have today in the settings and move the tax money on time.
Use Rate Review, Hiring Plan and Utilisation By Month before you raise prices, hire or promise more work.
Plan tasks and leave on Tasks And Workload and Leave And Cover so cover is agreed before people are away.

Use the 14 calculators for utilisation, hourly rate, client profit, price increases, hiring, cash runway, invoices, late fees, retainers, break-even, tool cost, bonus pool, extra work and leave cover.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 step-by-step checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Team And Finance Dashboard and Charts every week: overdue money, utilisation, profit, cash, tax and clients that lose money.

listing.title: Social Media Management Team, Time, Billing and Finance Excel Template: Timesheet, Invoices, Profit by Client, Cash Flow
listing.headline: Timesheet, invoices, profit and cash for your social media agency
listing.description:
Know what every client really earns you. This Excel workbook turns your hours, invoices and costs into profit by client, profit by package and a monthly profit and loss for a social media agency or freelance manager.

Log every block of work on Timesheet and see its cost and value. Team Members and Utilisation By Month show billable hours against the hours each person has, and Rate Review shows what a rate increase would add. Invoices adds tax, payments, balance, days overdue and late fees, Payments Received shows who pays late, and Receivables Ageing tells you exactly whom to chase. Recurring Retainers, Price Increases and Out Of Scope Work protect your income.

Expenses and Tool Subscriptions show the cost of your tools for each client. Monthly Profit And Loss, Cash Flow Forecast and Tax Set Aside look twelve months ahead so cash and tax never surprise you, and Hiring Plan shows what each new hire must earn to pay back.

14 calculators cover utilisation, hourly rate, client profit, price increases, hire or not, cash runway, invoices with tax, late fees, retainer or project, break-even, tool cost, bonus pool, extra work and leave cover. Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 checklists and send 28 WhatsApp messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part eight of the Social Media Management suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for 30 brands to explore first. It helps you plan your finances and does not give tax or legal advice.

messages.text: Hi, invoice {inv_id} for {brand} is ready: {total} including tax, due on {due}. Thank you for working with us.
Hi, a friendly reminder that invoice {inv_id} for {brand} ({balance}) is due on {due}.
Hi, invoice {inv_id} for {brand} was due on {due} and {balance} is still open ({days_over} days). Could you pay it this week?
Hi, invoice {inv_id} is {days_over} days overdue. As agreed, a late fee of {late_fee} now applies to the balance of {balance}. Can we settle it today?
Thank you for your payment on invoice {inv_id}. We received {paid} and {balance} is still open. Please send the rest by {due}.
Thank you, invoice {inv_id} for {brand} is paid in full.
Thank you, we received {amount} on {date} for invoice {invoice}.
Thank you for the payment of {amount}. It came {days_to_pay} days after the invoice. Could we move your payment date earlier next time?
Hi, your account with us: billed {billed}, paid {paid}, open {open}. Please tell us if anything looks different from your records.
Hi, {b3} for {brand} is more than 60 days overdue. We need to agree a payment date today so that the work can continue.
Hi, we understand cash can be tight. We can split the open {open} into two or three payments. Which dates suit you?
Hi, your next retainer invoice of {fee} plus tax goes out on {next_inv}. Please tell us if the billing details changed.
Hi, we paused your retainer of {fee}. When you are ready to restart, tell us and we will plan the first posts within a week.
Hi, thank you: we have worked together for {months} months. We will send a short review of results and ideas for the next quarter.
Hi, your request "{task}" is outside the package. It needs about {hours} hours and costs {charge}. Shall we go ahead?
Hi, we added "{task}" ({charge}) to your next invoice as agreed. Thank you.
Hi, we did "{task}" this time without charge (worth {charge}). Please tell us before similar requests so we can plan them.
Hi, from {effective} your monthly fee for {brand} changes from {fee} to {new_fee}. We are happy to talk it through.
Hi, a reminder that the new fee of {new_fee} starts on {effective}. Do you have any questions?
Thank you for accepting the new fee of {new_fee} from {effective}. We will keep delivering great results.
Hi, over the last 12 months we logged {hours} hours for {brand} on a fee of {fee} a month. Let us review the scope together so the plan stays fair for both of us.
Hi {name}, your billable utilisation over the last 90 days is {util} ({bill90} of {avail90} hours). Can we talk about your workload this week?
Hi {name}, you logged {hours90} hours in the last 90 days, with room for more. Can you take on a few extra posts?
Hi {member}, your {kind} from {start} to {end} ({wdays} working days) is approved. Please hand over open tasks before you go.
Hi {cover}, can you cover for {member} from {start} to {end} ({wdays} working days, {hours_lost} hours)?
Hi, the task "{title}" for {brand} is due on {due} with {left} hours left. Do you need help?
Hi, the task "{title}" for {brand} was due on {due} and is not done. Can you tell me the new date?
Thank you, "{title}" for {brand} is done after {hours_done} hours.

paragraphs: Invoice {col:inv.inv_id} from {set:firm}, issued on {col:inv.issued} to {col:inv.brand}.
Service: {col:inv.kind}. Net amount {col:inv.net}, tax {col:inv.tax}, total {col:inv.total}. All amounts are in {set:currency}.
Please pay by {col:inv.due} ({set:terms} days terms). A late fee of {set:late_pct} of the open balance applies after {set:grace} days.

Invoice {col:inv.inv_id} for {col:inv.brand} of {col:inv.total} was due on {col:inv.due}. {col:inv.paid} has been paid and {col:inv.balance} is still open. Status: {col:inv.state}.

If you already paid, please send us the transfer details so we can match it.

documents.title: Late fee notice

Invoice {col:inv.inv_id} for {col:inv.brand} is {col:inv.days_over} days overdue with a balance of {col:inv.balance}.
As agreed, a late fee of {col:inv.late_fee} is added after {set:grace} grace days.

de.Open Start and type your agency name, yo: Öffnen Sie Start und geben Sie Ihren Agenturnamen, Ihre Währung, die Steuer auf Rechnungen, Ihre Zahlungsbedingungen, Ihren Standardsatz und Ihre Kosten pro Stunde sowie Ihre Ziele in die gelben Zellen ein.
de.Fill Team Members with each person, thei: Füllen Sie Teammitglieder mit jeder Person, ihren Kosten pro Stunde, der Auslastungsrate und den Kundenstunden pro Woche aus. Stunden, Auslastung und Arbeitsbelastung werden aus der Arbeitszeittabelle eingetragen.
de.Log every block of work on Timesheet: da: Protokollieren Sie jeden Arbeitsblock in der Arbeitszeittabelle: Datum, Person, Marke, Art der Arbeit, Stunden und ob sie abrechnungsfähig ist. Geben Sie den Preis, den Zeitaufwand und den Wert ein.
de.Raise each invoice on Invoices and each: Erhöhen Sie jede Rechnung auf Rechnungen und jede Zahlung auf Eingegangene Zahlungen. Geben Sie Steuern, Saldo, Überfälligkeitstage und die Verspätungsgebühr ein, und Alterung der Forderungen zeigt an, an wen Sie sich wenden müssen.
de.Keep Recurring Retainers and Price Incre: Halten Sie Wiederkehrende Honorare und Preiserhöhungen auf dem neuesten Stand, damit Sie das nächste Rechnungsdatum, die Einnahmen pro Jahr und den Zusatz jeder Erhöhung kennen.
de.Write every extra request on Out Of Scop: Schreiben Sie jede zusätzliche Anfrage auf Außerhalb des Umfangs liegende Arbeiten, damit der Preis und der noch zu erstattende Betrag nie vergessen werden.
de.Enter expenses and tool subscriptions. P: Geben Sie Ausgaben und Werkzeugabonnements ein. Gewinn durch den Kunden und Profit By-Paket zeigen, wo das Geld verdient und verloren wird, und Monatlicher Gewinn und Verlust fügt den Overhead hinzu.
de.Check Cash Flow Forecast and Tax Set Asi: Überprüfen Sie jeden Monat Cashflow-Prognose und Steuer beiseite gelegt, legen Sie in den Einstellungen fest, wie viel Bargeld Sie heute haben, und überweisen Sie die Steuergelder rechtzeitig.
de.Use Rate Review, Hiring Plan and Utilisa: Verwenden Sie Bewertung bewerten, Einstellungsplan und Nutzung pro Monat, bevor Sie die Preise erhöhen, einstellen oder mehr Arbeit versprechen.
de.Plan tasks and leave on Tasks And Worklo: Planen Sie Aufgaben und reisen Sie am Aufgaben und Arbeitsbelastung und Gehen und abdecken ab, damit der Versicherungsschutz vereinbart wird, bevor die Leute abwesend sind.
de.Use the 14 calculators for utilisation,: Verwenden Sie die 14 Rechner für Auslastung, Stundensatz, Kundengewinn, Preiserhöhungen, Einstellungen, Cash Runway, Rechnungen, Verzugszinsen, Vorschüsse, Break-Even, Werkzeugkosten, Bonuspool, Mehrarbeit und Urlaubsschutz.
de.Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 1: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Briefe aus, folgen Sie 10 Schritt-für-Schritt-Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um WhatsApp mit dem fertigen Text zu öffnen.
de.Read Team And Finance Dashboard and Char: Lesen Sie jede Woche Team- und Finanz-Dashboard und Diagramme: überfälliges Geld, Auslastung, Gewinn, Bargeld, Steuern und Kunden, die Geld verlieren.
de.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle Auswahllisten dieser Datei. Ändere hier einen Eintrag, und er wird in allen Tabellen übernommen.
de.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wird anhand deiner Tabellen aktualisiert. Ändere das Jahr, um frühere Daten anzusehen.
de.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Wähle die gelbe Zelle aus; der Rest wird automatisch ausgefüllt. Druckbereit.
de.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Bearbeite den Text hier; Wörter in {Klammern} werden aus jeder Zeile übernommen. Die Verknüpfungen findest du in den Tabellen.
de.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Wähle einen Eintrag aus: Für jeden Schritt wird das Fälligkeitsdatum berechnet. Erstelle für jeden Eintrag eine Kopie dieses Tabellenblatts.
de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.

nl.Tax to set aside and moved, by month: Belasting opzij te zetten en verplaatst per maand
nl.Billable and available hours by member: Factureerbare en beschikbare uren per teamlid
nl.Open Start and type your agency name, yo: Open Start en typ uw bureaunaam, uw valuta, de belasting op facturen, uw betalingsvoorwaarden, uw standaardtarief en kosten per uur en uw doelstellingen in de gele cellen.
nl.Fill Team Members with each person, thei: Vul Teamleden in met elke persoon, de kosten per uur, het afrekentarief en de klanturen per week. Uren, bezetting en werklast worden ingevuld vanuit de urenstaat.
nl.Log every block of work on Timesheet: da: Registreer elk werkblok op de urenstaat: datum, persoon, merk, soort werk, uren en of het factureerbaar is. Het tarief, de tijdskosten en de waarde worden ingevuld.
nl.Raise each invoice on Invoices and each: Verhoog elke factuur op Facturen en elke betaling op Ontvangen betalingen. Belasting, saldo, te late dagen en de boete voor te late betaling worden ingevuld, en Vorderingen verouderen laat zien wie er achtervolgd moet worden.
nl.Keep Recurring Retainers and Price Incre: Houd Terugkerende houders en Prijs stijgt up-to-date, zodat u de volgende factuurdatum, de inkomsten per jaar en de extra's die elke verhoging met zich meebrengt, weet.
nl.Write every extra request on Out Of Scop: Schrijf elk extra verzoek op Werk buiten bereik, zodat de prijs en het nog terug te vorderen bedrag nooit vergeten worden.
nl.Enter expenses and tool subscriptions. P: Voer uitgaven en gereedschapsabonnementen in. Winst per klant en Winst per pakket laten zien waar het geld wordt verdiend en verloren, en Maandelijkse winst en verlies voegt de overhead toe.
nl.Check Cash Flow Forecast and Tax Set Asi: Controleer elke maand Cashflowprognose en Belasting opzij gezet, stel het geld dat u vandaag heeft in de instellingen in en maak het belastinggeld op tijd over.
nl.Use Rate Review, Hiring Plan and Utilisa: Gebruik Beoordeel beoordeling, Aanwervingsplan en Gebruik per maand voordat u de prijzen verhoogt, meer werk inhuurt of belooft.
nl.Plan tasks and leave on Tasks And Worklo: Plan taken en vertrek op Taken en werkdruk en Vertrekken en bedekken, zodat de dekking wordt afgesproken voordat mensen weg zijn.
nl.Use the 14 calculators for utilisation,: Gebruik de 14 rekenmachines voor benutting, uurtarief, klantwinst, prijsverhogingen, inhuur, cash runway, facturen, late vergoedingen, provisies, break-even, gereedschapskosten, bonuspool, extra werk en verlofdekking.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 1: Druk 10 vellen en 10 brieven af, volg 10 stapsgewijze checklists en tik op een berichtlink om WhatsApp te openen met de tekst gereed.
nl.Read Team And Finance Dashboard and Char: Lees elke week Team- en financieel dashboard en grafieken: achterstallig geld, gebruik, winst, contant geld, belasting en klanten die geld verliezen.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
